We propose the Extract Excelsior and Expand framework (Ex3) to automatically construct storyline by learning from raw novels, and generate new novels that imitate the linguistic style of a specific genre... Our approach has the capability to generate a long-form novel by giving a short premise.
The realm of automatic long-form novel generation through artificial intelligence holds significant appeal both in academic and practical domains...
datasets: 800 web novels collected from the internet

quote: automation metrics are as follows: • Self-BERTscore: Calculate the BERTscore between each adjacent pair of sentences within the novel... • Generation Perplexity: Average perplexity of all sentences... • Distinct Ratio: Percentage of overall vocabulary to the number of tokens... • Protagonist Ratio: Ratio of roles in the novel that appear more than a specific threshold...
We evaluate the novel by both human study and automation metrics. The automation metrics are as follows: Self-BERTscore, Generation Perplexity, Distinct Ratio, Protagonist Ratio.
We select 10 premises from the human evaluation experiments and compare the distribution of different automation metrics between the human-written novels and generated novels.
